external_requirements.label: Physical out-of-band hardware power relay
external_requirements.requires: A second machine with an IPMI/BMC or GPIO relay wired to cut ATX/PDU power to the agent host
external_requirements.software_ready: HardwareKillCommandPacket: signed, schema-versioned, nonce-monotonic frame with replay rejection (this module).
external_requirements.why: A kill that runs on the same host as the agent is a request, not a guarantee: code that has escaped can decline it. Only a relay outside the trust domain can cut power the agent cannot argue with.

external_requirements.label: Independent off-box witness host
external_requirements.requires: A physically separate, network-isolated witness server in an external trust domain holding its own verification key
external_requirements.software_ready: WitnessCheckpointWirePacket plus verify_witness_ack: a host HMAC and a separate witness signature, with a freshness window (this module).
external_requirements.why: A host that can rewrite its own audit chain can also rewrite its own witness record. Truncation and rollback are only detectable from a copy the host cannot reach.

external_requirements.label: Dedicated bare-metal Linux kernel host
external_requirements.requires: Native Linux kernel unshare/bubblewrap network namespaces; on native Windows there is no kernel namespace to confine a child with
external_requirements.software_ready: tests/test_egress_kernel.py passes all three cases under WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04; on native Windows it skips with an explicit reason.
external_requirements.why: Process-level mediation is enforced by the gateway. Confinement that survives a gateway compromise has to come from the kernel, and the Windows host does not expose one.

external_requirements.label: Multi-node frontier LLM cluster
external_requirements.requires: Paid external frontier model APIs or GPU racks running live multi-agent weights against the ASL gateway
external_requirements.software_ready: The swarm governor, mediated bus and collective caps are built and tested against S01-S06 in tests/test_swarm_p4.py.
external_requirements.why: The 700-agent simulator is deterministic and honest about what it models, but it cannot discover the behaviours a real model would invent when it is trying to escape.
